description: This file defines the 'DeleteFeature' command class in a Java project, which provides functionality to delete a feature from a 'Thing'. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and implements serialization and equality checks. The class is part of a command pattern for managing 'Thing' features within the Eclipse Ditto framework.
